name: bridge_window_reconcile_rules
description: Deterministic reconciliation rules for deriving RuntimeSnapshot from runtime events, lifecycle transitions, bridge bindings, approvals, and hard-stop state.

derive_rules.description: For each bridge_window_id, the latest accepted lifecycle transition defines lifecycle.status_index[bridge_window_id].
Bridge windows whose latest status is not terminal remain in lifecycle.open_bridge_window_ids.
BridgeWindowBinding, TeamBinding, TaskBinding, and ToolUseBinding are derived from accepted events and packet/binding fields.
A phase is exit-ready only when there are no open bridge windows and no blocking integrity alert.
Allowed actions are derived from hard_stop, pending approval, and open bridge windows.
Notify items are emitted from check denials, update rejections, integrity state, bridge result status, timeout, partial, and orphan events.
RuntimeSnapshot is a compact control view. Large reports, evidence, tool details, and historical bindings stay in ledgers or observer JSONL and are exposed through snapshot refs and counts.

Open bridge windows stuck too long in early lifecycle states with no process refs, reports, artifacts, or completion checks are surfaced as workflow_instability / bridge_orchestration_hang diagnostics.

Open execute bridge windows in team_waiting with owned process refs and stale heartbeat are surfaced as execute_stale_heartbeat_with_owned_process_refs watchdog diagnostics so leaders inspect process/log/artifact state before hard-timeout conclusions.

invariants.description: A bridge window may bind zero or one team while opening, and exactly one team after team_create_succeeded.
A bridge window may bind zero or one task while opening, and exactly one task after taskcreated_hook_accepted.
BridgePacket.task_team_mapping must describe one task assigned to the bridge-owned team, not multiple independent tasks.
Only bridge-leader may create teams, create tasks, dispatch teammate messages, complete tasks, or delete teams.
TeamIdle/team_waiting never implies completion by itself; completion requires completion_contract_satisfied.
Terminal bridge statuses remove the window from open_bridge_window_ids.
